question: On the WI-095 package (the WI-094 costed C-1 assembly with the loop return requirement enforced by an explicit primary-side bypass control): which of the round-1 leading operating points satisfy the completed loop model and with what bypass fraction (arrangement B); where the exactly matched settings lie at each flow (arrangement A, the bypass fraction at a tiny target); and how the performance and cost comparison reads on cases that satisfy the completed model. No point is optimized inside the model; the boundary ratio is a study-level root solve on the package-owned oracle with the ratio then a chosen input of the executed case.

axes.basis: C-1 design flow 2,500 kg/s (WI-093); window 2,000-4,000 kg/s (-20 % / +60 %) fixed by the 54-point screen (contract § 8 a, § 11).
axes.missing_response: No off-design machine map: the compressors and turbine keep fixed isentropic efficiencies at every flow (S1 tests uniform offsets); the loop sits upstream and its rated flow is unchanged.

axes.basis: C-1 equal-stage ratio 1.5183 (the ARIES designer's choice); window 1.20-1.80 refined to 0.025 between 1.30 and 1.50 where the screen located the heat-removal boundary (contract § 11).
axes.missing_response: One value applied to three independent chosen inputs: a declared equal-stage scenario, not a physical tie (annex § Declared ties); no off-design map (S1).

axes.basis: I-R baseline 3,200 MW (WI-093 re-selection); I-A 1,600 MW, the ARIES-selected rating (WI-090 E4 reference).
axes.missing_response: A violated screen keeps its booked price; nothing is resized from a demand (MR-7).

axes.basis: I-R 7,000 MW; I-A 3,500 MW (ARIES-selected).
axes.missing_response: As compressor_rating.

axes.basis: I-R 3,600 MW; I-A 1,800 MW (ARIES-selected).
axes.missing_response: As compressor_rating.

axes.basis: I-R 5,000 MW; I-A 2,500 MW (ARIES-selected).
axes.missing_response: As compressor_rating; heat-rejection pumping is not in the balance (contract § 8 c).

axes.basis: I-R 3,500 MW; I-A 1,500 MW (ARIES-selected).
axes.missing_response: As compressor_rating.

axes.basis: ARIES 0.89; 0.85 / 0.92 span the WI-090 range (contract S1). One value applied to the three stages.
axes.missing_response: A uniform offset; it cannot test a penalty that grows with distance from the design point (contract § 8 a).

axes.basis: ARIES 0.93; 0.90 / 0.95 (contract S1).
axes.missing_response: As compressor_efficiency.

axes.basis: ARIES register 20 MW coupled at 0.5 wall-plug efficiency (40 MW electric); x0.5 / x1.5 with the rest of the register; the labelled Stellaris-equivalent register uses 50 MW coupled (100 MW wall-plug, baseline.json).
axes.missing_response: A constant of the sweep: it moves absolute net and the net-positive edge, not the ranking (contract § 6, S2).

axes.basis: ARIES 10 MW; x0.5 / x1.5; Stellaris-equivalent 2.14 MW (cryogenic and shield, baseline.json).
axes.missing_response: As aux_heat.

axes.basis: ARIES 5 MW; x0.5 / x1.5; 0 in the labelled Stellaris-equivalent register (no counterpart named in the contract).
axes.missing_response: As aux_heat.

axes.basis: ARIES 5 MW; x0.5 / x1.5; 0 in the labelled Stellaris-equivalent register.
axes.missing_response: As aux_heat.

axes.basis: ARIES 5 MW; x0.5 / x1.5; the Stellaris-equivalent register puts its cooling-water pumping 13.02 MW here (baseline.json), the bound on the omitted heat-rejection pumping.
axes.missing_response: As aux_heat.

axes.basis: 0 as in C-1 (so the controls replay bit-exactly); the wired case sets it to the fuel chain's stored exhaust rate 1.7893e22 atoms/s, about 1.79 MW at the balance's 1e-22 MW per atom/s (contract § 3, S2).
axes.missing_response: A disclosed constant omission of the main block.

axes.basis: Stellaris 329,187.19 Pa reference loop pressure drop; x0.5 / x2 (contract S3). It moves the loop pump electricity and the friction heat delivered together.
axes.missing_response: The loop pump law is the Stellaris relation with its constants, not a hydraulic model (contract § 8 g).

axes.basis: ARIES E4 reference prices at x1; x0.5 / x1.5 on the seven priced items of the inventory (contract S4).
axes.missing_response: Prices decide the USD/MWh value of a net gain and the I-R against I-A comparison, not the operating ranking.

axes.basis: The rest-of-plant constant 2,158,230,133.33 USD2004 at x1 ([ASSUMED], contract § 6); x0.5 / x2 (S4).
axes.missing_response: As equipment_price_factor.

axes.basis: 0 under the no-credit convention; 100 kg/year is the ARIES E6 named-feed scenario (contract S5).
axes.missing_response: Breeding is unsupported: the feed is an assumption, not a calculated capability (contract § 8 f).

axes.basis: 0; 30 MUSD/year with the named feed (ARIES E6 convention, contract S5).
axes.missing_response: As tritium_feed.

axes.basis: ARIES 50,000 m2 (UA 50 MW/K at the assumed 1,000 W/m2K); 75,000 m2 is the one declared priced hardware alternative (ratio 1.5, 87,488,550 USD2004 through the same purchase law; contract § 5, S6).
axes.missing_response: A labelled alternative inventory, never a point-by-point resize (MR-7).
